title: How Urvi works in production for Cairn Oil & Gas (Vedanta)
intro: Single-Agent, Multi-Tool Hybrid Architecture — natural spoken & typed language in (Gemini ADK / Live) → deterministic engineering physics, ML models & numeric-grounding guards underneath (best of both worlds with minimal hallucination). Same agent, same tools, governed production data. Cairn / Vedanta upstream systems feed the Vedanta Enterprise Data Lakehouse in Google Cloud Mumbai (asia-south1); Urvi reads governed well health and intervention tables; Urvi and Gemini run in India regions with VPC Service Controls and CMEK.

sections.heading: A question, step by step
steps: Users reach Urvi through Identity-Aware Proxy with Vedanta single sign-on and role-based access control (COO / CIO, Asset Manager, Production Engineer). Typed and voice traffic both enter here.
The same service as the demo, on Cloud Run in Mumbai (asia-south1), scaling with load.
The same single agent and tools as the demo; persona and field access are enforced.
Gemini on Vertex AI India regional endpoints. Cairn / Vedanta data is never used to train models.
The same engineering tools, plus nightly scores from the trained recommendation models.
A governed data-access adapter replacing the demo's baked parquet files.
The adapter reads the curated Well Health & Opportunity tables through a scoped consumption API (or governed BigQuery Silver/Gold views).

sections.heading: Voice
steps: The Live proxy connects to Gemini Live on an India regional endpoint at go-live.
Voice tools call the same analytics code as chat.

sections.heading: Where the data comes from
steps: AVEVA / OSIsoft PI Historian & Pad SCADA (MPT Nagana, RGT, Jet-Pump/ESP telemetry) [verify], SAP S/4HANA PM/MM (work orders, rig schedule, MRO spares) [verify], and WellView / Subsurface Well-File DMS (DWRs, CBLs, completion tallies) [verify] feed the on-site collector.
Curated telemetry aggregates, work orders, and documents transfer to Mumbai over a private encrypted link (Cloud Interconnect).
Ingested into Bronze → Silver → Gold in asia-south1 (Mumbai) using Dataflow / BigQuery / Dataform.
Governed Well Health and dossier facts are published via Apigee / Consumption API, which Urvi reads (step 7).

sections.heading: Two other routes (dashed)
body: Route B: raw high-frequency historian data remains on-site and Urvi, in asia-south1, queries only aggregated well metrics over the private Interconnect API.

Route P (pilot): before full enterprise connectors go live, Barmer Basin exports a masked pilot slice of mature Mangala / Bhagyam / Aishwariya / Raageshwari wells to a CMEK-encrypted Mumbai GCS bucket.

sections.heading: Security, residency and governance in India
body: Mumbai (asia-south1) serves as primary region and Delhi (asia-south2) as disaster-recovery region; all data, models, and logs remain resident in India.

Vedanta holds encryption keys (Cloud KMS, CMEK / EKM); a VPC Service Controls perimeter prevents data exfiltration; Access Approval enforces customer sign-off for support access; audit logs are retained in India and forwarded to Vedanta security monitoring.
